audit.why: Packet levelChart is [Quinn x6, Skill]. The page was rendering a Quinn win at two items directly above prose describing Sejuani flipping fights.

audit.why: Quinn levels 1-3, level 6 roam, first-item lethality, Sejuani at tank items and R are all present and correctly ordered. Glacial Prison's 120/105/90s cooldown now anchors the late row.

audit.whatIsWrong: The whole page treats Permafrost as a cooldown to dodge. Permafrost's cooldown is 1.5s — it is never 'down'. It fires only against a target at MAXIMUM Frost stacks, built by Winter's Wrath (W, 9s at rank 1) and her autos. Also unstated: Sejuani's stun and Glacial Prison cancel Behind Enemy Lines, which is a channel.
audit.why: Riot text: 'Sejuani freezes and stuns an enemy champion that has maximum Frost stacks.' Advising the player to wait out a 1.5s cooldown is actively wrong; the real counterplay is denying the stacks. Quinn's R carries the channel flag and the missing-interactions entry flags P/E/R as cancels.
audit.corrected: Advice rebuilt around denying Frost stacks and around not channelling R inside her stun range; Arctic Assault (Q) named as the 18s gap-closer that is genuinely trackable.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns named Permafrost as the punishable cooldown; it is not, at 1.5s.
audit.why: Arctic Assault at 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s is the actual punishable cooldown in this lane — it is her only gap-closer.
audit.corrected: Both cooldowns stated with numbers and the correct one flagged as the window.
